ui_intent: Pricing comparison surface with enough structure to render a dense matrix instead of two vague cards

plans.label: Free
plans.tagline: Validate edge without getting copyable live timing.

plans.label: Pro
plans.tagline: Live strategy dashboard, causality traces, and honest performance framing.

value_stack.headline: Timing fidelity stays front and center
value_stack.body: Pro keeps live urgency windows, decision timing, and operator-ready ladders visible instead of collapsing everything into a generic feed.

value_stack.headline: Glass Box visibility keeps the trust story intact
value_stack.body: Users are buying the ability to inspect whether the timing envelope was clean, not just the existence of a signal.

value_stack.headline: Metric honesty survives the sales page
value_stack.body: Aggregate PF and Avg Daily PF remain paired so the flattering metric never hides the stricter one.

value_stack.headline: Operator density beats oversized empty SaaS chrome
value_stack.body: The paid shell is about ranked strategy context, proof continuity, and scan-fast panels that still hold up on mobile.

comparison_rows.feature: Exact live timing and urgency window
Avg Daily PF methodology and live metrics
Backend connection to your MCAS endpoint

faq.q: Does Pro unlock on every device automatically?
faq.a: Not in the front-end-only implementation. Activation is local to this browser until a secure entitlement backend exists.

faq.q: Why show Avg Daily PF and aggregate PF together?
faq.a: Aggregate PF shows the total run. Avg Daily PF shows how repeatable the edge looks day by day.

faq.q: Why is the free tier intentionally incomplete?
faq.a: It should validate edge without exposing enough timing detail to clone the workflow.
